title: Starbase Live: 24/7 Starship & Super Heavy Development From SpaceX's Boca Chica Facility
summary: NASASpaceflight's 24/7 live stream from SpaceX's Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas, showing Starship and Super Heavy development, testing and launches.
why: Linked during Starship launches and testing as a live view that needs no login and shows the rockets actually being built.

quote.text: You can also watch them actually build.
